title: Ranger Block III (Rangers 6 to 9)
credit: Echoes of Exploration team (modelled in code from NASA reference drawings and photos)
note: Ranger Block III in flight: hexagonal aluminium bus 1.5 m across with six equipment cases, polished conical shroud with one opening for the six TV cameras (aimed 38 degrees off the long axis), cylindrical omni antenna on top (3.6 m from engine to tip), two 0.74 x 1.54 m solar panel wings spanning 4.6 m with cells facing sunward (down), 1.2 m high-gain dish hinged under one corner, mid-course motor with jet vanes and the nitrogen gas jets. Simplified: wiring, the internal camera electronics and small brackets are left out; the dish's 1.2 m size and deployed angle are taken from photos.
